_provenance: The hosted AWS MCP Server (https://aws-mcp.us-east-1.api.aws/mcp) through mcp-proxy-for-aws@1.7.0. NOT a live recording: no AWS account was available when this was written (2026-10-07). The tool NAMES are the eight a live tools/list returned in users' wire captures on aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws issue #293 (after aws___call_aws was removed on 2026-08-31). AWS publishes no input schemas: only aws___run_script's is given, as AWS's own code calls it ({"code": <Python>}, in aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws PR #296); the other seven carry an open object schema because no route uses them. Re-record with a live `tools/list` (spec 078 T-C0/T-C12) when an operator profile is available.

tools.name: aws___run_script
